include(GNUInstallDirs)

# mayonnaise_app(<binary> ID <desktop id> SOURCES <files...>)
#
# Builds an application and installs it as its own CMake install component (named like the binary), so
# packages can be split per app: `cmake --install build --component photos`. Each app ships
# data/<desktop id>.desktop and data/<desktop id>.svg (generated by tools/make_app_icons.py); the desktop id
# is also the Wayland app_id / X11 class, passed to mayo::App through MAYO_DESKTOP_ID.
function(mayonnaise_app name)
  cmake_parse_arguments(APP "" "ID" "SOURCES" ${ARGN})
  add_executable(${name} ${APP_SOURCES})
  target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE mayonnaise::mayonnaise)
  target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE MAYO_DESKTOP_ID="${APP_ID}")
  mayonnaise_set_warnings(${name})
  mayonnaise_set_sanitizers(${name})
  install(TARGETS ${name} RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR} COMPONENT ${name})
  install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/data/${APP_ID}.desktop
          DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/applications COMPONENT ${name})
  install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/data/${APP_ID}.svg
          DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps COMPONENT ${name})
endfunction()

add_subdirectory(photos)
add_subdirectory(video_player)
add_subdirectory(task_manager)
add_subdirectory(finder)
add_subdirectory(terminal)
add_subdirectory(system_settings)
add_subdirectory(calculator)
add_subdirectory(music)

add_subdirectory(mail)
add_subdirectory(text_editor)
add_subdirectory(app_store)
add_subdirectory(portal)
